info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Apex REST API

description.content:
Create custom REST endpoints in Salesforce using Apex classes annotated with @RestResource. Supports OAuth 2.0 authentication and JSON and XML request and response formats. Custom Apex REST endpoints are accessed under the /services/apexrest/ URL namespace. Each endpoint is defined by an Apex class with @HttpGet, @HttpPost, @HttpPatch, @HttpPut, and @HttpDelete annotated methods.
